results.summary: Phase 005 compiled-serving claim holds: manifest and executed route agree on hash and generation.

noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to this lineage and neither restates a closed 014 item: the corpus gap is established by enumerating all 15 cases against the declared outcomes, and the override asymmetry by comparing the two activation-root declarations.

title: The admission canary corpus never exercises the declared three-mode bundle or the canonical ids
The engine ignores the activation-root override the resolver honours

detail: P1: the 15-case corpus has one two-mode bundle case and no three-mode or canonical-id case, while resolve.cjs:34 names it as the admission basis.
P2: compiled-route.cjs:29 hardcodes the activation root while resolve.cjs:24 honours SPECKIT_ACTIVATION_ROOT_OVERRIDE, so the documented test isolation is incomplete.
